name: commander
description: Stand up a runnable dispatch-and-score loop inside a repo: a single-file constitution that turns any model into a commander who dispatches tasks to subagents, scores the output on a three-layer pyramid (mechanical gate → report contract → fresh-context judge), attributes every failure to the layer that let it through, and patches the harness so the next run is easier. Ships the constitution, the report protocol, the task template, a dispatch script and an L1 scorer, plus the run-ledger scaffold. Self-canonical (no harness-neutral playbook counterpart, not part of the vendoring sync).
